structured.feedback: Good: it meets every hard requirement. It runs about 210 words of Markdown under clear subheadings and pairs each feature with a benefit. It tones down the source's claims ("water-resistant" instead of waterproof, "help remove" instead of "maximum performance") and leaves out the weaknesses reviewers raised. It mentions customer opinion only once, invents no quotes, includes no links and ends with a call to action. Two small things could be better: a few sentences are passive, and it never uses the "charcoal" keyword from the product title, which costs some SEO value.
